channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Wayne Ellington | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Wayne Ellington from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Wayne Ellington, Frank Jackson
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Frank Jackson:

“He's worked hard this summer and that's what Frank does. He's active. I think he learned from Wayne Ellington on how to move without the ball. His activity on the offensive end is hard to keep up with.”

Dwane Casey on Wayne Ellington, Frank Jackson, Oct 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Duncan Robinson on Wayne Ellington
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Duncan, on playing against @Wayne Ellington:

“It's a taste of my own medicine, I guess. I really should say it's Wayne's medicine. I learned so much from him.”

Duncan Robinson on Wayne Ellington, Jan 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on Wayne Ellington
item.description:
“A lot of the times when I don’t get that many shots it could be the [other team’s] scheme. They could be packing the paint. Then I’m trying to get the win. Some games guys are going better than others. There’s sometimes I was trying to force it to Wayne Ellington because he was knocking down a lot of shots and I was just trying to keep it going.”

Hassan Whiteside on Wayne Ellington, Feb 2, 2018. Source: Miami Herald.
